success.description: 4+{Dc} A location or area within medium range of you is buried under an avalanche of snow and ice, knocking all creatures in that area prone and striking them for 2 + Int damage

boon.description: # Each creature in the avalanche gains the Sluggish condition until this spell recharges
You may exclude up to 2 creatures in the area from being affected by the avalanche

bane.description: The avalanche is out of control! It goes far beyond the desired area

sigmarsComet.description: The entire area is chilled by snow and ice. For the duration of the encounter, you may treat the current season as winter

reckless.requirements: 6 power. Must be either outdoors or within long range of a quantity of snow or ice
